subject: Sounds like a good idea...
author: FrozenVapor
body: Sounds like a good idea... Phil is very good at organizing tournaments, though, and posting the tourneys on Xbox.com helps get more people interested. Don't know if you meant for this new tournament to be another "Phil" event but hosted on burnoutaholics.com, or a whole different thing. Maybe both tourneys could run at once, the BurnoutAholics one more laid back and with a focus on B2/B3 as well as Revenge.

subject: BurnoutAholics Tournaments
author: ZombieTron
body:
We will certainly support any Tournaments as we have done with the Fall Tourney by supplying space on the site etc. So, if any users want to run Tourneys we will help in any way we can. But neither Xandu or myself have enough time to organise a tournament ourselves at the moment.

If any users want to organise a tournament on Revenge, Takedown or Paradise (when its eventually released) we can help out with advice on formats etc and possibly BurnoutAholics prizes!

--- The Original and the Best ---
